notes.title: [New Events] Creature Gone, Cirque de la Lune, and more!
notes.content:
Greetings DFO adventurers!

With today's update comes these awesome new events!

[b][u][Creature Gone][/u][/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25789815/5d45d04e6f414b8b0d805de1b3d47c6f8bb50c65.jpg[/img]

Did you take your creature for granted? Creatures left unnamed, starved and left alone in the inventory have decided they've had enough! They’ve gone on a trip to the Canvas Town where they will be given the love and attention they deserve! You must convince them to come back before they get there! Hurry!

More details on Creature Gone can be found here.
http://www.dfoneople.com/news/events/view/Creature-Gone

[b][u][Cirque de la Lune][/u][/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25789815/d8e429522182bd2f1eb0ae0b66f2c17b53fe815e.png[/img]

A mysterious and a magical circus arrives in Arad! Enter into the dungeon full of clowns, monkeys and gorillas. Make your way to the final room to defeat the Lion! With a small chance, you may be able to encounter the crazy, petulant daughter of the leader named Ring Ring. Fight her for the ultimate challenge!

More details on Cirque de la Lune can be found here.
http://www.dfoneople.com/news/events/view/Cirque-de-la-Lune

You can visit our official webpage for the full list of on-going events!
http://www.dfoneople.com

Hope to see you in Arad! :)

- Dungeon Fighter Online Support Team -

notes.title: Introducing a new class: Demonic Lancer
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25789815/0c89f21202689153cd29e9b44a18e135847558e4.png[/img]

The lost children of Sirocco...
Now, they have raised their lances against the nobles of the empire.
Demonic Lancers abandoned their ambition and headed to Silver Crown to find a way to lift their accursed power and free themselves from the cycle of chaos...

Neople proudly introduces the long-anticipated new class: [b][url=http://www.dfoneople.com/news/updates/474/New-Class:-Demonic-Lancer]DEMONIC LANCER[/url][/b]

Demonic Lancer can advance into two upper classes, 'Vanguard' & 'Skirmisher'.

[list][*][b][url=http://www.dfoneople.com/news/updates/474/Advancement:-Vanguard/Advancement:-Vanguard]Vanguard[/url][/b]
Vanguards use heavy and powerful slashes to annihilate enemies in a wide range with halberds as a main weapon.

[*][b][url=http://www.dfoneople.com/news/updates/474/Advancement:-Skirmisher/Advancement:-Skirmisher]Skirmisher[/url][/b]
 Stabbing/piercing is the Skirmisher's preferred style of attack. They are best at quickly engaging the enemy then quickly pulling back to safe distance with long lances as a main weapon.[/list]

Feel their fierce spearmanship from deep grudge and agony!

Visit our [url=www.dfoneople.com]website[/url] for more update and event information!

tags.feature: Neople proudly introduces the long-anticipated new class: DEMONIC LANCER

The lost children of Sirocco...
Now, they have raised their lances against the nobles of the empire.
Demonic Lancers abandoned their ambition and headed to Silver Crown to find a way to lift their accursed power and free themselves from the cycle of chaos...

Neople proudly introduces the long-anticipated new class: [b][url=http://www.dfoneople.com/news/updates/474/New-Class:-Demonic-Lancer]DEMONIC LANCER[/url][/b]

Demonic Lancer can advance into two upper classes, 'Vanguard' & 'Skirmisher'.

[list][*][b][url=http://www.dfoneople.com/news/updates/474/Advancement:-Vanguard/Advancement:-Vanguard]Vanguard[/url][/b]
Vanguards use heavy and powerful slashes to annihilate enemies in a wide range with halberds as a main weapon.

[*][b][url=http://www.dfoneople.com/news/updates/474/Advancement:-Skirmisher/Advancement:-Skirmisher]Skirmisher[/url][/b]
 Stabbing/piercing is the Skirmisher's preferred style of attack. They are best at quickly engaging the enemy then quickly pulling back to safe distance with long lances as a main weapon.[/list]

Feel their fierce spearmanship from deep grudge and agony!

Visit our [url=www.dfoneople.com]website[/url] for more update and event information!

notes.title: Blitz Gift -Skeleton Key-
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25789815/9d8432c74fb46ce9458702c029e72122b783ab59.jpg[/img]

Thanks to your support and interest, we could successfully launch DFO service on STEAM.
We are happy to see the current and new players enjoying the game and getting along with one another.


To express our gratitude, we have prepared a small gift to everyone.


Starting from [b]09:00 of Aug 16 to 09:00 of Aug 23, 2016 (UTC)[/b], you will be given [b]a Daily Skeleton Pouch[/b] generating three Skeleton Keys daily upon logging in the game.
We hope that this helps your adventures in the world of Arad.


[b][u]The item is not tradable, usable for Lv.30 or higher and will be deleted on 09:00 Aug 23, 2016.[/u][/b]


Please look forward to the Demonic Lancer on the next update as well ːsteamhappyː


We will be back with bigger presents.
Thank you for your love for DFO.


- Dungeon Fighter Online Support Team

notes.title: Upcoming New Character : Demonic Lancer
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25789815/ed9b3760243767b0e55d43acbf2f85b2f5f933dc.jpg[/img]

Greetings, adventurers!

How is everyone enjoying their adventures in Arad?
A big thanks to all adventurers for passionately welcoming DFO’s return to STEAM!

Today, we have a [b]big announcement[/b] that everyone will love to hear. ːsteamhappyː
Many of you have already predicted it, but now he’s finally here. The one and only ‘Machanga’… I mean [b]Demonic Lancer[/b]!

Demonic Lancers are battle slaves of the Empire who, in order to survive, had to fight and slay their own kins. Now they are carrying out their revenge against the Empire. 

If you want to find out more about the lore of Demonic Lancer and its subclasses, please check out the link below! 

[b][i][url=http://www.dfoneople.com/news/updates/New-Character-Demonic-Lancer] Demonic Lancer Teaser Site [/url][/i][/b]

- Dungeon Fighter Online Support Team

notes.title: DFO is now on STEAM!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25789815/2ad34811635b822a7228b9fa8ecf96dea0483dc3.png[/img]
Greetings DFO adventurers,

We are happy to announce that Dungeon Fighter Online is now available on STEAM! 

Download the game through STEAM and check out slew of events we have prepared to help you settle in and start your adventure! Follow the link below to get details on the on-going events.

[list]
[*][url=www.dfoneople.com/news/events/view/Level-Maketh-Man] Level Maketh Man [/url]

[*][url=www.dfoneople.com/news/events/view/Legendary-Event] Legendary Event [/url]

[*][url=www.dfoneople.com/news/events/view/Lucky-7] Lucky 7 [/url]

[*][url=www.dfoneople.com/news/events/view/Daily-Delivery-August-2016] Daily Delivery [/url]

[*][url=www.dfoneople.com/news/events/view/DFO101STEAM] DFO 101: STEAM™ [/url]

[*][url=www.dfoneople.com/news/events/view/DFO-X-SteamAttendance-Event] DFO X Steam™ Attendance Event [/url]

[*][url=www.dfoneople.com/news/events/view/Honey-Time-STEAMed] Honey Time: STEAM™ed [/url][/list]

Also, you may check out STEAM exclusive contents such as achievements, badges, DLCs and trading cards! So much fun awaits!

See you in the world of Arad ! :)

-Dungeon Fighter Online Support Team-
